Ekta Diwas: Delhi Flags Off Run For Unity; PM Narendra Modi To Lead Ekta Parv In Kevadia
India marks Rashtriya Ekta Diwas to honour the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. In New Delhi, dignitaries, including the President of India, Union Home Minister, and Delhi Chief Minister, paid floral tributes at Patel Chowk and flagged off the Run for Unity from the Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium. The marathon saw extensive participation from youth, students, and volunteers heading towards India Gate. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Narendra Modi is in Ekta Nagar, Kevadia, Gujarat, to offer floral tributes at the Statue of Unity, inaugurate developmental projects worth around 400 crore rupees, and lead the Ekta Parv parade in the evening. This year's parade highlights national integration alongside key themes such as a Naxal-free India, 150 years of Vande Mataram, and anti-drug campaigns, featuring displays by paramilitary daredevils, state police, and regional cultural troupes.
Ekta Diwas 2026: Run For Unity Held Across India; PM Narendra Modi To Lead Kevadia Parade
Across India, celebrations for National Unity Day or Rashtriya Ekta Diwas are underway to commemorate the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. In New Delhi, the Run for Unity commenced from Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium, flagged off by Union Home Minister Amit Shah alongside local dignitaries. Events featuring students, NCC, and NSS volunteers were organised nationwide to bolster integration. In Kevadia, Gujarat, Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid floral tributes at the 182-metre Statue of Unity and inaugurated development projects worth approximately 400 crore rupees for Ekta Nagar. The evening schedule includes an Ekta Parade showcasing paramilitary forces, Cobra Commandos, state police contingents, cultural tableaus, and bike rallies. A key theme of the parade highlights a Naxal-free India, featuring 2,000 youths from formerly affected districts in special performances alongside commemorative tributes marking 150 years of Vande Mataram.
Run for Unity Flagged Off in Delhi on Rashtriya Ekta Diwas; PM to Lead Ekta Parv
India marks Rashtriya Ekta Diwas on the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, honouring his role in the political integration of the country. Dignitaries, including the Union Home Minister and the Chief Minister of Delhi, flagged off the Run for Unity from the Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium in New Delhi. The route proceeds through India Gate towards the statue of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose, with traffic regulations reported along Bhagwan Das Road, Purana Qila Road, and Mathura Road. Organised across multiple cities nationwide under the spirit of Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat, the event sees thousands of participants taking part. Prime Minister Narendra Modi appealed to citizens, especially the youth, to participate from Kashmir to Kanyakumari and Kutch to Kamakhya, and is scheduled to lead the Ekta Parv at Ekta Nagar in Gujarat.
ISRO Launches NVS-03 via GSLV-F18 to Boost NavIC Regional Navigation
The Indian Space Research Organisation has successfully launched its next-generation navigation satellite, NVS-03, aboard the GSLV-F18 rocket from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh. Marking the 20th flight of the Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle, the rocket placed the 2,250-kilogram satellite into a Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit. NVS-03 is the third satellite in ISRO's second-generation navigation series designed to bolster and sustain the NavIC constellation. The satellite features an indigenously developed rubidium atomic clock alongside signals in the L1, L5, and S bands, reducing dependence on foreign navigation systems like GPS and GLONASS for civilian, commercial, and strategic requirements. ISRO confirmed the satellite is healthy with solar panels deployed. Officials noted that five more launches are planned for the financial year alongside preparations for the uncrewed Gaganyaan mission.
hi_body:
भारतीय अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान संगठन (ISRO) ने GSLV-F18 रॉकेट के माध्यम से NVS-03 नेविगेशन उपग्रह का सफलतापूर्वक प्रक्षेपण किया है, जिससे भारत की स्वदेशी NavIC प्रणाली को मजबूती मिली है। अधिकारियों ने पुष्टि की है कि 170.3 किलोमीटर गुणा 38,080 किलोमीटर की कक्षा में स्थापित किए जाने के बाद उपग्रह प्रणालियाँ और सौर पैनल सामान्य रूप से काम कर रहे हैं।

## मिशन की मुख्य विशेषताएं और तकनीकी विवरण

* **प्रक्षेपण यान:** नेविगेशन पेलोड ले जाने वाला GSLV-F18 रॉकेट।
* **कक्षा पैरामीटर:** इसे 170.3 किमी गुणा 38,080 किमी की कक्षा में स्थापित किया गया।
* **परमाणु घड़ी:** क्षेत्रीय स्थिति निर्धारण के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण घटक के रूप में भारत की तीसरी स्वदेशी परमाणु घड़ी को स्थापित किया गया।
* **उपयोग:** यह क्षेत्रीय स्थिति निर्धारण, नागरिक आवश्यकताओं और रणनीतिक नेविगेशन सेवाओं के लिए उन्नत समर्थन प्रदान करता है।

## नेतृत्व की सराहना और भविष्य की योजनाएं

प्रधान मंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने ISRO के वैज्ञानिकों और इंजीनियरों की सराहना की और इस प्रक्षेपण को तकनीकी आत्मनिर्भरता को आगे बढ़ाने में एक महत्वपूर्ण मील का पत्थर बताया। इसके अलावा, ISRO ने चालू वित्तीय वर्ष के भीतर पाँच अतिरिक्त प्रक्षेपण करने की अपनी योजनाओं की घोषणा की है, साथ ही पहले मानव रहित गगनयान मिशन की दिशा में प्रगति जारी रखी है।

## व्यावहारिक निहितार्थ और सत्यापन

* **विश्वसनीयता:** उन्नत क्षेत्रीय पोजिशनिंग सिग्नल नेविगेशन बुनियादी ढांचे में सुधार करते हैं।
* **सत्यापन:** नागरिक और शोधकर्ता ISRO की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट और सार्वजनिक घोषणाओं के माध्यम से अपडेट की जांच कर सकते हैं।
* **सुरक्षा:** सामान्य टेलीमेट्री स्थिति स्थिर तैनाती का संकेत देती है।

en_body:
The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully launched the NVS-03 navigation satellite aboard the GSLV-F18 rocket, strengthening India's indigenous NavIC constellation. Officials confirmed that the satellite systems and solar panels are functioning normally following its injection into an orbit of 170.3 kilometres by 38,080 kilometres.

## Mission Highlights and Technical Details

* **Launch Vehicle:** GSLV-F18 rocket carrying the navigation payload.
* **Orbit Parameters:** Injected into an orbit of 170.3 km by 38,080 km.
* **Atomic Clock:** Deployed India's third indigenous atomic clock to serve as a critical timing component.
* **Application:** Provides enhanced support for regional positioning, civilian needs, and strategic navigation services.

## Leadership Recognition and Future Outlook

Prime Minister Narendra Modi commended ISRO scientists and engineers, describing the launch as an important milestone in advancing technological self-reliance. Looking ahead, ISRO announced plans to carry out five additional launches within the current financial year while steadily progressing towards the first uncrewed Gaganyaan mission.

## Practical Implications and Verification

* **Reliability:** Enhanced regional positioning signals improve navigation infrastructure.
* **Verification:** Citizens and researchers can review official updates directly via ISRO's verified public announcements and mission briefings.
* **Safety:** Confirmed normal telemetry status indicates stable deployment.
